name: GĀN DÈNG YǍN 干瞪眼
description: Gan Deng Yan is a Chinese climbing and shedding game in which most responses must be exactly one rank higher than the previous combination. Players begin with small hands, draw from a talon after each trick, and try to be first to shed all cards.

content.text: Gan Deng Yan is a Chinese climbing and shedding game in which most responses must be exactly one rank higher than the previous combination. Players begin with small hands, draw from a talon after each trick, and try to be first to shed all cards.
Gan Deng Yan emerged in southwest China during the early to mid-2010s, with reported roots in Sichuan and documented play in Yunnan variants.
2 to 6 players, with each player competing individually.
Dealer shuffles, then players draw cards in counterclockwise order until dealer has 6 cards and each other player has 5. Remaining cards form a face-down talon.

items.text: Double-Deck Group Play: Some groups use two 54-card packs for larger player counts, increasing hand volume and reducing early talon exhaustion.
Triplets as Ordinary Combinations: Some tables treat triplets as ordinary combinations rather than bombs, allowing one-step triplet responses.
